stories.title: Seahawks bring team spirit to Sammamish Safeway for Home Team Harvest
stories.summary: Blitz, dancers and receiver Montorie Foster Jr. surprised Thanksgiving shoppers Monday night while rallying support for Northwest Harvest's 26th annual campaign.

stories.title: ICE 'out of control' in dramatic SEA arrest caught on camera, governor says
stories.summary: Dramatic video showed masked ICE officers detaining two passengers on a jet bridge at SEA Airport Saturday morning.

stories.title: Northbound I-5 between Lacey and Tacoma reopens after multi-car crash
stories.summary: WSDOT reported the crash around 6:20 a.m. The Washington State Patrol told KING 5 around seven to eight vehicles are involved.

stories.title: 'So cruel': Husband of woman detained by ICE at SEA Airport says ICE operations must change
stories.summary: José Castillo said federal officers "stalked" his family through SEA Airport, rushed them without identification and traumatized the family and other passengers.

stories.title: Renton-based Wizards of the Coast sues Utah family for $26.5 million over alleged counterfeit Magic cards
stories.summary: Shopify shut down a store selling fake Magic cards in 2020. Wizards of the Coast says the seller moved offshore and kept growing.

stories.title: Man charged with attempted murder in Tacoma break-in, shooting now in custody
stories.summary: Documents allege a man kicked in a Tacoma door, hit the sleeping resident with a stick and shot him twice in the leg.

stories.title: Wilson cabinet official recommended to lead troubled King County Regional Homelessness Authority
stories.summary: Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson and King County Executive Girmay Zahilay announced Monday that they would recommend Mark Ellerbrook for the role of interim CEO.

stories.title: Marysville police rescue over 30 animals in neglect case
stories.summary: The Marysville Police Department investigates an animal neglect case where over 30 animals were rescued from hazardous conditions, leading to potential charges.

stories.title: 875,000 expected through SEA Airport for Thanksgiving, despite recent travel disruptions
stories.summary: The Port of Seattle says this year's passenger estimate is on par with 2025; AAA says about 6 million people will fly for the holiday nationwide.

stories.title: Shoreline, Edmonds school districts join pressure campaign on I-638 lawsuit
stories.summary: The Shoreline School District may file an amicus brief, while the Edmonds School District is open to pursuing legal action.

stories.title: Seattle eyes a World Cup encore with 2031 Women's World Cup bid
stories.summary: Seattle is among 30 cities vying to host the 2031 Women's World Cup games. Local leaders say last summer's success gives the city an edge.

stories.title: Seattle's South Park prepares for flooding during king tides
stories.summary: Residents in South Park near the Duwamish River brace for possible flooding as exceptionally high tides loom, recalling past devastation.
